in_marathi.name: Hitesha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hitesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hitesha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hita' which means 'welfare, happiness'. The suffix 'sha' means 'shining, radiant'. Thus, Hitesha means 'one who shines or illuminates the welfare or happiness'.
